definition: to make someone agree with your idea
description: In a sunny stone courtyard under a grapevine pergola, a young woman with curly hair in a lilac cropped jumper and black trousers holds a small brown puppy and gives a half-reluctant smile. A young man in a rust shirt over a white T-shirt and beige trousers reaches out, scratches the puppy's chin and leans in close to it. She softens, laughs and lifts the puppy up happily as he smiles. A metal water bowl and a striped blanket lie on the flagstones by a blue wooden door.

taps.phrase: to lean in towards the puppy
